comment: The store builds of the extension that a release host lets in. Each entry is chrome-extension://<32-letter id>/ with the trailing slash. Put the Chrome Web Store id in chrome_web_store and the Edge Add-ons id in edge_add_ons once each listing exists. build-release-local.ps1 and the host's --check-release refuse a release while both lists are empty, or when either holds the development id from allowed-origins.dev.json.
